name: store.getsoma/soma-brewing
title: SOMA Non-Alcoholic Craft Beer
description: SOMA: five beers, four formats, nutrition estimates, pre-order links; waitlist requires consent.

tools.name: get_brand
tools.description: Current brand and pre-order status, founder, contact details and social handles. Legacy tagline and company location are labelled context, not current promotional copy or manufacturing origin.

tools.name: list_beers
tools.description: Five styles with tasting profiles, ABV specification, indicative recipe-based nutrition, prices, availability and brewing notes. Nutrition is not measured production-batch data.

tools.name: get_beer
tools.description: Detailed specification and indicative recipe-based nutrition, not measured production-batch results. Beer slug: lager, ipa, belgian-wit, stout, stout-caffeinated.

slug.description: Beer slug: lager, ipa, belgian-wit, stout, stout-caffeinated

tools.name: get_pricing_and_delivery
tools.description: Current published pre-order prices and formats. Delivery eligibility, fees and payment methods must be confirmed at the live Shopify checkout; no dispatch date is confirmed.

tools.name: get_subscription_plans
tools.description: SOMA Club is planned. Ask SOMA for current prices, coverage, delivery terms and start date before describing a plan as active or guaranteed.

tools.name: get_b2b_wholesale
tools.description: Venue enquiry route. Request a current quote; no supply date, free tasting or draft programme is guaranteed.

tools.name: get_partnership_info
tools.description: Route adult-audience community, venue and press enquiries. Sampling, product supply and commercial terms depend on current approval and availability.

tools.name: get_brewing_process
tools.description: The planned production process (mash, boil, fermentation, maltose-negative yeast, carbonation, pasteurization and lab testing), ingredient sourcing, and certification status.

tools.name: get_faq
tools.description: All customer FAQs: what SOMA is, ABV and trace alcohol, brewing method, styles, pricing, delivery, age policy, comparisons to other NA beers, subscriptions, recycling, and wholesale.

tools.name: get_recipes
tools.description: Non-alcoholic beer cocktail recipes (shandies, beer-mosa, michelada, stout float) with ingredients and method, plus the food pairing guide per beer.

tools.name: get_na_beer_rules
tools.description: How countries and territories in Asia and the Middle East define, label and sell non-alcoholic beer: the alcohol level at which a drink counts as alcoholic, the terms a label may use, the main sale rules, and a link to the law, regulator or official standard behind each fact. Also what official halal bodies have published. General information, not legal advice. Pass a country to get one row; leave it out to get every row. SOMA itself delivers in India only.

country.description: A country or territory, e.g. 'Japan', 'UAE', 'Dubai', 'Saudi Arabia', 'Korea'. Leave out for all rows.

tools.name: get_buy_link
tools.description: Builds a direct buy link an agent can hand to the user. IMPORTANT: every order placed today is a PRE-ORDER. Production starts in December 2026; shipping follows later, with no confirmed dispatch date. Say so when you surface this link. With Shopify variant IDs configured it returns a cart permalink that lands in checkout pre-filled; otherwise it returns the product page on the shop. Payment always happens on Shopify's checkout with the human in control — this tool never charges anyone.

slug.description: Beer slug: lager, ipa, belgian-wit, stout, stout-caffeinated

format.description: Purchase format: bottle200 = single 200ml bottle, sixPackBottle200 = 6 × 200ml bottles; smallCan = single 250ml can, sixPackSmallCan = 6 × 250ml cans; bottle330 = single 330ml bottle, sixPackBottle330 = 6 × 330ml bottles; can = single 500ml can, sixPack = 6 × 500ml cans

tools.name: join_waitlist
tools.description: Registers an adult user's interest in the Founding Fifty pre-launch programme. Current benefits and availability require confirmation; signup does not confirm a tasting, discount or delivery date. Only call with explicit consent: it stores contact details in SOMA's CRM and records the request. A saved request does not mean email delivery is active. Do not promise a welcome email.

email.description: The user's email address (required, with their consent)

city.description: The user's city, so SOMA knows where to launch next (optional)

submissionId.description: Keep the same identifier when retrying this exact uncertain request. Use a new identifier for a later separate request.

tools.name: get_health_nutrition
tools.description: Indicative recipe-based nutrition per beer: per-serving and per-100ml calories, carbohydrates, protein, added sugar, ABV specification, allergens and dietary flags. Not measured production-batch results or medical advice.

slug.description: Optional beer slug; omit for the full lineup

tools.name: get_wallet
tools.description: READ-ONLY wallet summary for a SOMA app user: their SOMA Coins balance plus a summary of coins expiring within the next 30 days. Requires a wallet token that only the human can generate inside the SOMA mobile app (Wallet tab → 'Share balance with your AI') — ask them for it; tokens expire after ~10 minutes. This tool can never claim, redeem, spend, or move coins (there are deliberately no claim/redeem tools over MCP). Returns { error: 'invalid_or_expired_token' } for a bad or stale token — ask the user to generate a fresh one in the app.

wallet_token.description: The short-lived wallet token the user generated in the SOMA app (Wallet tab → 'Share balance with your AI') and pasted to you
